title: A look at ByteDance's efforts to become China's leading company across all aspects of AI, from frontier models and video generation to infrastructure and chips (Financial Times)
summary: Financial Times: A look at ByteDance's efforts to become China's leading company across all aspects of AI, from frontier models and video generation to infrastructure and chips — The Chinese company behind TikTok is pouring resources into the technology. Some think it is a big gamble.
